title: Urban Wind Lab: An interactive lattice-Boltzmann tool for wind analysis
description: Interactive lattice-Boltzmann wind analysis for 3D urban context, built for teaching architecture students. A D3Q19 lattice-Boltzmann solver with a Smagorinsky sub-grid model and an atmospheric boundary layer log-law inlet runs in the browser, reporting wind speed, amplification, pressure coefficient and Lawson pedestrian comfort classes. One self-contained HTML file with no build step and no dependencies.
